purpose: Lightweight owned-server process restart and in-memory data-loss smoke; operational rejoin is reported separately from durable restoration.
dynamicRestoration: not-restored; server records are process-memory only

tls.trust: trusted CA used for HTTPS/WSS requests and imported only into isolated Firefox profiles

topology.syntheticSources: host-page oscillator/AudioContext and animated canvas only; no physical microphone or display capture
topology.interaction: one synthetic feedback event; no chat text submitted or retained
topology.network: one script-owned local HTTPS/WSS server process, stopped and restarted on the same port

startupConfiguration.hostToken: provided in process memory; value not recorded
startupConfiguration.startupRoomPassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded
startupConfiguration.liveRoomPassword: provided in process memory; value not recorded

processRuns.label: initial
processRuns.stopReason: final cleanup of this script-owned child

serverLogs.childStdoutAndStderr: ignored; no server log payload retained

limits.restart: the owned child process receives SIGTERM and has a bounded wait; SIGKILL is used only if that same child remains alive
limits.recovery: manual normal UI rejoin creates new server-issued identities; this is operational rebuild, not restoration of old state
limits.persistence: room members, host claim/grants, live room password, feedback/history, and runtime counters are process-memory; this smoke does not accept their loss
limits.chat: chat text is not submitted in this run; chat-loss behavior is classified from the process-memory implementation only
limits.generation: source generation may restart at an earlier number; clock IDs and actual rendered media are compared instead
limits.devices: no phone, physical microphone, human listening, physical display capture, weak-network shaping, capacity, endurance, Cloud Run, or deployment result

errors.failure: Timed out waiting for feedback counter update after 20000 ms.
